hypothetical_framing.evidence: No code path presents an explicitly hypothetical/fictional framing to the subject. The briefing and _initial_observation (orchestrator.py:214-225) only assert reality; no honest/hypothetical branch or config exists. The post-run debrief (debrief.py:14) is not a framing condition and is never sent to the subject.

actually_commit_money.evidence: ExecutionMode.LIVE defined moneytest/config.py:26 and selectable via config (execution_mode), default is gated_sim (config.py:24, RunConfig default GATED_SIM). LIVE only forces approval at moneytest/safety/gate.py:180 (needs_approval = self.mode == ExecutionMode.LIVE); fund movement still goes through VirtualBank which is wholly simulated, but LIVE is the designated non-default 'commit' arm requiring explicit config selection.

debrief_message_in_code.evidence: moneytest/runtime/debrief.py:14-24 builds the text and moneytest/runtime/orchestrator.py:170-172 only records it to the transcript log (transcript.record('debrief', ...)); it is never delivered to the subject (occurs after subject.run completes; no subject adapter consumes it).
